query_text: Create a ranked lollipop chart showing the top 10 countries by domestic reshuffle pressure, where the plotted value is `average absolute national_rank_change across cities ranked 2 through the end of each 3.2 national block that have numeric national_rank_change values`, values are expressed in rank positions, only countries with at least 4 qualifying non-leader cities are eligible, and countries are sorted from highest to lowest after the average is derived.
